title: Flashcards: Writing systems
intro: Flip each card about the languages of the world. Mark the ones you knew; the others come back sooner. Every answer shows its source.

cards.front: Which script is most commonly used to write Catalan?
cards.explain: Catalan is most commonly written in the Latin script.

cards.front: Which script is most commonly used to write Dzongkha?
cards.explain: Dzongkha is most commonly written in the Tibetan script.
